page.title: Review Video Library
page.subtitle: 2 types: "Connection video" (reviewing in-class vocabulary) and "Reflex video" (Q&A speaking practice). Each set contains multiple videos/audio clips, and the curriculum framework assignment is ONLY for filtering/search — explicitly assigning to specific class(es) is what controls visibility. Publishing only marks a set as eligible to be used as a source — a teacher must pick a published set as "next session's homework" in Student Comments before it's actually assigned to a class; the system then tracks the actual watch percentage.
